description: Writes the requirements document before any code — a PRD in the repo's docs tree or a spec published to the tracker: objectives, user stories, success criteria, testing strategy, boundaries, out-of-scope and a Plans table. Maps the capabilities and their dependency order first when one ask bundles several modules. Turns a finished conversation into the spec by pure synthesis, without re-interviewing. Use when starting a project or feature with no spec yet, when asked to draft a PRD or define the requirements, when told "write a spec", "spec this out", "turn this conversation into a spec" or "write up what we discussed", or when a multi-capability requirement needs a capability map before specifying.
